description: This file defines an abstract base class for repository adapters, a concrete implementation for GitLab, and associated data models and utility functions. It enables resolving commit SHAs and fetching project metadata from GitLab repositories.

classes.name: RepoInfo
classes.description: Data model representing repository information, including provider, project ID, branch, commit SHA, and optional metadata.

classes.name: BaseRepoAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class for repository adapters, enforcing interface for resolving commits and fetching project metadata.

classes.name: GitLabAdapter
classes.description: Concrete implementation of BaseRepoAdapter for GitLab using GitLab's REST API.

methods.name: Optional[str] resolve_commit(self, project_id: str, branch: str)
methods.description: Abstract method to resolve commit SHA for a branch/ref.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_project_metadata(self, project_id: str)
methods.description: Abstract method to fetch project-level metadata.

methods.name: RepoInfo get_repo_info(self, project_id: str, branch: str, commit_sha: Optional[str])
methods.description: Method returning a combined RepoInfo object for a project.

methods.name: str provider_name(cls)
methods.description: Class method returning the provider name, e.g., 'gitlab'.

methods.name: Tuple[int,Any] _request(self, method: str, url: str, **kwargs)
methods.description: Internal method to perform HTTP requests to GitLab API endpoints.

methods.name: None aclose(self)
methods.description: Method to close the HTTP client connection.

methods.name: __init__(self, base_url: str, token: Optional[str], timeout: float = 15.0)
